caption:
The video depicts a close point-of-view shot of a hooded figure wearing a white skull mask, aiming a shotgun directly toward the lens. The gun’s barrel and pump, along with a black-gloved hand, occupy the right foreground, while the masked person stays centered. The background shifts from a brick wall and tall windows into an interior bank lobby, where recessed ceiling lights and a “BANK” sign become visible. Edge blur indicates the camera moves or rotates relative to the scene, not that the gunman changes his aim.

As the excerpt continues, the “BANK” lettering slides across the upper frame, then drifts left, revealing glass partitions and darker lobby elements. The horizon and ceiling tilt in a changing Dutch angle, while the masked shooter’s torso and weapon remain almost unchanged. His gloved hand grips the forend, and the weapon points very close to the viewer. The scene moves around him, so the visible action is sustained aim amid camera movement, not a completed approach or withdrawal. The subject maintains a consistent pose and aim relative to the lens throughout.
